summary: Tested Maria's move to Tampa in kalshi_demo mode, backend and frontend, at 390px. Everything requested passed. (1) GET /api/quote Tampa/45/daily/2026-10-25 returns available true, price_source 'demo', p 0.04 (the demo best ask, about 10,600 contracts within 3¢) and yes_ask 0.04, which equals production. Albuquerque shows the split clearly: yes_ask 0.37–0.40 (production) while p is 0.54 (demo book). Chicago's empty demo book still shows production odds (1%). (2) End-to-end in the UI, one booking: Today was preselected; the widget read 'Add a rain refund for $2.31' and 'Get your $45 back if it rains on Sunday, October 25th.' with '4% chance of rain'. Toggle on, name TEST_tampa, no email, total $47.31, then confirm. POST returned 200 and showed 'Booking confirmed', "You're covered: $45 back if it rains on Sunday, October 25th." and 'Hedged: 45 contracts @ 4¢ on Kalshi (Kalshi demo · filled)'. db.orders had mode kalshi_demo, status filled, kalshi_order_id 01a173c8-c948-7f07-9c74-fec465b634cc and cost $1.92. Kalshi demo shows the order executed (45 contracts, $1.80 plus fees). Demo balance is now $92.21. (3) Dashboard: subtitle 'Patio restaurant · Tampa', 'Tampa this weekend: 8% chance of rain' (production about 7%, not 0%), badge 'Orders on Kalshi demo', TEST_tampa at the top as Covered, 42 covered, hedge log '45 contracts @ 4¢ Kalshi demo · filled $1.92'. (4) Tomorrow (22%) and Weekend (7%) show 'No sellers on Kalshi right now · rain chance X%'. Tapping the toggle does nothing; no name or email fields appear. (5) The landing page loads and the ticker shows Chicago, NYC, Miami, Seattle and Austin. (6) create_guarantee now deletes the booking on any exception (verified in-process with a RuntimeError, so no orphan). (7) Cleanup: the TEST_ guarantee and its order were purged by the conftest teardown. Maria is back to 41.

minor.issue: On an unexpected place_hedge exception the booking is now deleted (verified), but the bare re-raise returns a 500 with no user-facing message. Consider returning 502 'Couldn't place the hedge — no charge' so the checkout shows a friendly error.

issues: The rain-refund-toggle has no accessibilityRole='switch' or accessibilityState (checked/disabled). The web DOM shows no aria-checked or aria-disabled, so screen readers can't tell it is off or unavailable.
The 'Tomorrow · Monday, October 26th' date chip is cut off at 390px (horizontal scroll). That's acceptable, but there is no scroll affordance.
The customer list shows 5 rows plus 'Show 5 more' while 'Bookings covered' is 42. The list is capped at 10 recent bookings, so the label suggests only 10 exist.

action_items: Optional: map unexpected hedge exceptions in create_guarantee to a 502 with a 'no charge' message, not a raw 500.
Optional: add accessibilityRole='switch' and accessibilityState={{checked:on, disabled:!available}} to the rain-refund toggle.
Optional: dashboard 'Show N more' should reflect the total (or say 'Show recent'), because only 10 recent bookings are returned.
